title: Omnibus-enquete Gemeente Lelystad 1995 - VSO
descriptions: Opinion of inhabitants of Lelystad about living in Lelystad and several aspects of the municipal policy. Position of r. at the labour market / victimization / intentions to move / political issues / rating of problems in Lelystad / preferred financial municipal policy / type of contacts with municipality and appreciation / following municipal information / municipal taxes / r.'s opinion about the survey and the questionnaire. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics
